ShortDescription.Value: Customize City Start, milestones, budget tools, milestone rewards, and optional network demolition costs.

Publish.LongDescription:
### Budget + Milestones
Set up the city the way you want — normal start, harder start, or a quick head start.
#### City Start - Keep normal milestone progression or start at a milestone you choose. - Set starting money for the next limited-money city. - Disable milestone cash bonuses if you like a challenge. - Real challenges: add demolition cost based on the network's construction cost when removing roads, paths, rail, pipes, cables, and other networks. - The game's normal refund for recently built networks still applies (yes, the game gives you a refund if you demo a road you just built).
#### Unlimited Money Converter - Convert an Unlimited Money save to normal limited-money city. - Make a backup first as the conversion can not be reverted.
#### Budget Tools - Add or subtract a chosen amount with hotkeys. - Optional Auto Add Money can keep your balance above a selected threshold. - Subtract Money can take the balance below zero, just like the game allows.
#### Good to know - Some tools were originally in [City Watchdog (CWD) mod](https://mods.paradoxplaza.com/mods/144908/Windows); now spun-off and expanded here (and removed from CWD). - Lightweight design: safe to remove, no Harmony patch, or impact on city.
#### Languages Supported English, Deutsch, Español, Français, Italiano, 日本語, 한국어, Polski, Português Brasileiro, Português Portugal, ไทย, Türkçe, Українська, Tiếng Việt, 简体中文, and 繁體中文.
